summary: This Docker Compose configuration sets up a single n8n service (a workflow automation tool) that runs continuously, exposes itself on localhost port 5678, stores its data in a persistent volume, and uses Brussels timezone. It's a minimal setup for running n8n locally.

explanations.4: The 'unless-stopped' policy means Docker will automatically restart the container if it crashes, but won't restart it if you explicitly stopped it.
explanations.6: This binds port 5678 inside the container to 127.0.0.1:5678 on your machine, so only your local computer can access it (not from other machines on your network).
explanations.10: Instead of storing data inside the container where it'd be lost when the container stops, this mounts a named volume so n8n's configuration persists between restarts.
